chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Salih, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I was circumambulating the House, and there was a man saying, 'What is the matter that these two corners are touched and those two are not touched?' So I said, 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) touched these two and did not bother with those two. Therefore, do not bother with those two when the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) did not bother with them.'
ai.seo_question: Which corners of the Kaaba are touched during Tawaf and what is the prophetic precedent?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the ritual distinction between the Black Stone (Hajar al-Aswad) and the Yemeni Corner (Rukn al-Yamani), noting that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) kissed the former but merely touched or passed by the latter. This hadith establishes the scholarly consensus that the 'two corners' (Ruknain) specifically refer to these points, grounding the practice in the Prophet's direct actions rather than mere geometric symmetry.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Salih, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘I<sup>asws</sup> was circumambulating by the House (Kaaba), so there was a man saying, ‘What is the matter these two corners are touched and those two corners are not touched?’ So I<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> touched these two and did not bother with those two. Therefore you should not bother with those two when Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> did not bother with (touching) them’.
en.sarwar: 9. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Salih who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said. ‘Once I was performing Tawaf when I heard a man say, “Why is it that these two corners are touched and these two are not touched?” I said, “The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, touched these two and did not bother about those ones. So do not bother about what the Messenger of Allah did not do.’”
Jamil has said, ‘I saw abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, touch all the corners.’
